description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. - Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

The Demand Planner at Zwiesel Fortessa America is a key role responsible for the precise and proactive execution of global supply planning activities, within the company’s open-to-buy financial parameters. Serving as a primary operational liaison with overseas manufacturers, this role embodies Zwiesel Fortessa’s professionalism, reliability, and collaborative spirit. The Planner interacts cross-functionally and internationally to ensure accurate fulfillment of supply objectives while upholding exceptional standards of detail, communication, and data integrity. The individual will work closely with Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to understand future volume requirements and production constraints, leveraging these analyses to effectively release replenishment orders. This position supports Zwiesel Fortessa America’s mission to deliver industry-leading service and supply performance for customers worldwide. 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Own and Execute Supply & Inventory Planning 

• Manage global production schedules, order cycles, inventory levels, and supplier lead times with critical attention to detail-always within ZFA  open-to-buy financial guidelines. 

• Maintain accurate, detail-oriented supply plans aligned with demand forecasts, product launches, and leadership objectives. 

• Closely monitor supply metrics (order fill rate, lead times, supplier performance) and take proactive action when targets are at risk to ensure financial and operational success. 

• Partner across Product, Sales, Finance and Operations team to analyze future volume requirements and production constraints; leverage these insights to time and release replenishment orders for inventory optimization and uninterrupted supply. 

• Communicate and collaborate to resolve conflicts between demand projections and supply capabilities, aligning efforts with company goals. 

• Own identification of supply chain risks, including delays, capacity issues, or supplier performance shortfalls, and escalate promptly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with actionable solution-based recommendations. 

Manage Supplier Relationships and Cross-Functional Communication 

• Serve as a Zwiesel Fortessa’s primary point of contact for overseas manufacturers, building and sustaining productive partnerships that meet quality, delivery, and service standards. 

• Maintain a thorough understanding of Zwiesel Fortessa’s product and vendor specifications, keeping up to date on the goods and services to be purchased to ensure orders are accurate and requirements are met. 

• Demonstrate adaptable communication skills to navigate diverse cultural and business environments, engaging with Product, Vendor Compliance, Finance, and Operations teams and global time zones. 

• Conduct regular supplier reviews, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions alongside internal and external partners. 

Drive Data Integrity, Problem Solving, and Continuous Improvement 

• Rigorously analyze supply chain and forecast data to identify risks, bottlenecks, and process gaps; develop actionable solutions to enhance reliability, cost-effectiveness, and support financial planning. 

• Ensure precise and timely documentation of all supply planning activities, transactions, and vendor communications, maintaining the highest standards of systems’ data integrity and regulatory compliance. 

• Prepare and present KPIs and insights for leadership to support financially responsible, data-driven decisions. 

• Lead and implement process enhancements using industry’s best practices and technology to drive efficiency, agility, cost control, and continuous improvement across the supply planning function. 

Minimum Qualifications 

• Bachelor’s degree required; preferred in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Logistics, or related field. 

• 3-5 years of relevant experience in supply planning, inventory management, or operational analysis, ideally

title: Responsable des mobilités entrantes - CDD 24 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.
La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable des mobilités entrantes pour rejoindre la Direction des Relations Internationale (DRI).

L’École a développé au fil des années une solide expertise dans l’attractivité et l’accueil des étudiants internationaux. À présent, les élèves de Télécom Paris (tous diplômes confondus) sont constitués de près de 40% d’internationaux représentant 40 pays. Toutes nos formations sont ouvertes aux étudiants internationaux. L’attractivité européenne est un enjeu important. De manière générale l’internationalisation de Télécom Paris s’appuie sur le développement de partenariats solides avec des établissements d’enseignement et de recherches de premier plan à travers le monde. Les accords établis prévoient des mobilités étudiantes à niveau master ou doctoral, simples ou diplômantes, des mobilités d’enseignants-chercheurs ou de personnels administratifs, des coopérations en recherche conduisant parfois à la mise en place de laboratoires communs.

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

• Assurer la gestion des mobilités internationales entrantes en cursus ingénieur et des programmes d’aide aux mobilités entrantes

• Développer les relations de l’École sur des zones géographiques internationales

Détails des missions dans la description de poste complète.

Vous disposez d’un excellent niveau de français et d’anglais (C1 minimum), à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Vous connaissez l’organisation de l’enseignement supérieur français, l’écosystème des institutions et des outils de la coopération internationale. Rigoureux(se), autonome et organisé(e), vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques et les techniques de communication. Doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez collaborer avec des interlocuteurs internationaux, avec diplomatie et réactivité. Vous faites preuve d’aisance rédactionnelle et d’un bon esprit de synthèse.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Vous travaillerez dans un environnement agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers, navette mutualisée en partance de la Porte d'Orléans). Vous bénéficierez de :

• 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT).

• Flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service).

• Télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible.

• Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne.

• A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé.

Découvrez notre environnement de travail, nos engagements en image et en vidéo sur notre page dédiée .

Indications de rémunération :
Fourchette indicative de rémunération (hors bonus annuel variable) : 36 000 à 46 000 euros bruts annuels, selon le profil et l’expérience, définie par notre cadre juridique. A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé.

Informations diverses :
Date limite de candidature : 31 décembre 2026
Type d'emploi : CDD de 24 mois
Le poste nécessite des déplacements en France et à l’étranger (d’une journée à une dizaine de jours par an).

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuelle et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Junior Legal Counsel
description:
ABOUT ZABLE

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

- Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

- The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

- Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

- Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

- Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

- Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

- Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join a small but ambitious Legal team with a broad remit, working with every part of the business, from Product and Engineering to Credit Risk, Marketing and People. Zable is an FCA-regulated lender operating in the UK, US and Mexico, so you'll get early exposure to regulated products and new markets. As Zable grows, this role is focused on commercial contracts, product and corporate work. You'll own matters end to end, explain legal issues clearly to non-lawyers, and weigh the legal position against what the business is trying to achieve.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements. You'll lead on supplier and customer contracts, engagement letters and NDAs, and support on partnership and other strategic contracts as you build towards leading them

- Manage our contract review process, including triaging incoming requests, providing templates and reviews, and managing the e-signature process (for example DocuSign) through to completion

- Respond to day-to-day legal queries from the business and our counterparties

- Drive process and knowledge management by building and maintaining document repositories, administering our contract management and AI tooling and helping us develop processes to support contract review and negotiation

- Support on intellectual property matters and litigious matters as they arise

- Take on company secretarial and governance work

- Support corporate and transactional work, including KYC / due diligence requests and diligence reviews on corporate projects

- Work closely with the rest of the Legal team to deliver timely, first-class legal support

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

- You'll help drive the business forward by taking the initiative and embracing work beyond your comfort zone

- You'll get to grips with new markets and financial products, bringing energy and curiosity to each new challenge

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- NQ - 2PQE, qualified in England & Wales, or in another common law jurisdiction with relevant UK experience

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, including explaining legal issues to non-lawyers

- Strong org
